title: CoSlice: Coordinated Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for 5G Network Slicing Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2611.23909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Radio Access Network (RAN) slicing is a shared resource allocation problem: each slice seeks to satisfy its Service Level Agreement (SLA) with minimal radio-resource consumption, while all slices compete for a limited resource budget. This creates both an intra-slice trade-off between SLA assurance and resource efficiency and an inter-slice conflict over shared resources, calling for specialized yet coordinated control. In this work, we present CoSlice, a coordinated multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for inter-slice physical resource block allocation in Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN). CoSlice uses preference-conditioned slice agents for fast resource allocation and an LLM-based coordinator to adapt their objectives using global network observations at a slower timescale. translated_title: CoSlice：面向5G网络切片资源分配的协调式多智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 无线接入网切片是一个共享资源分配问题：每个切片都力求以最少的无线资源消耗满足其服务等级协议（SLA），同时所有切片又在竞争有限的资源预算。这既造成了切片内部SLA保障与资源效率之间的权衡，也造成了切片之间对共享资源的冲突，因此需要专门化且协调一致的控制。在本工作中，我们提出了CoSlice，这是一个用于开放无线接入网（O-RAN）中切片间物理资源块分配的协调式多智能体强化学习框架。CoSlice使用基于偏好条件化的切片智能体进行快速资源分配，并使用基于大语言模型（LLM）的协调器以较慢的时间尺度、利用全局网络观测来动态调整这些智能体的目标。我们将该问题形式化为多目标部分可观测随机博弈，并建立了偏好相关均衡的存在性（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出CoSlice框架，将偏好条件化的切片智能体与基于大语言模型的协调器相结合，通过分层多智能体强化学习解决O-RAN中切片间物理资源块分配问题，在保障各切片SLA的同时实现整体资源的高效利用。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CoSlice, a hierarchical coordinated multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that combines preference-conditioned slice agents with an LLM-based coordinator to allocate physical resource blocks across slices in O-RAN, balancing SLA assurance and resource efficiency.
